# Report

**Read before writing:** Standards §1.1–§1.8, §1.7 (labels), §8.3 (every caption a label),
Appendix B (symbol-verify every table and field in the dataset).

## Ask / confirm

Needed: what the report lists (the table or tables, with the parent–child link when there are
two); the columns (default: the fields the human named, else the key, description, and the
amount or date fields — proposed in the confirmation box); the request-page filters
(`RequestFilterFields`: the key and a date or status field by default); sorting; the **layout**:
*Excel layout generated by the agent — one sheet, one column per dataset column (recommended for
a list or an export)* / *A minimal RDLC layout generated by the agent — one table, a header row* /
*I'll design the layout in Report Layouts in BC — the agent writes the dataset and request page
only* / *Processing only — no layout, the report does something*. Menu placement:
`UsageCategory = ReportsAndAnalysis` (default), `Tasks`, or `Documents`.

## Write

```al
namespace <Publisher>.<ExtensionShort>;

report <ID> "<PFX> Rental Unit List"
{
    ApplicationArea = All;
    UsageCategory = ReportsAndAnalysis;
    Caption = 'Rental Unit List';
    DefaultRenderingLayout = Excel;

    dataset
    {
        dataitem(RentalUnit; "<PFX> Rental Unit")
        {
            RequestFilterFields = "No.", "Customer No.", Status;
            column(No_; "No.") { IncludeCaption = true; }
            column(Description; Description) { IncludeCaption = true; }
            column(CustomerNo; "Customer No.") { IncludeCaption = true; }
            column(StartDate; "Start Date") { IncludeCaption = true; }
            column(Amount; Amount) { IncludeCaption = true; }
            column(Status; Status) { IncludeCaption = true; }
        }
    }

    requestpage
    {
        SaveValues = true;
        layout
        {
            area(Content)
            {
                group(Options)
                {
                    Caption = 'Options';
                    // option fields only when the human asked for one
                }
            }
        }
    }

    rendering
    {
        layout(Excel)
        {
            Type = Excel;
            LayoutFile = './src/Reports/RentalUnitList.xlsx';
            Caption = 'Rental Unit List (Excel)';
        }
    }
}
```

- **Excel layout** (BC 22+): the agent writes a minimal `.xlsx` beside the report — one sheet
  named `Data`, a header row with the column names exactly as the dataset names them, a table
  (`ListObject`) named `Data` over the header row — using `openpyxl` or an equivalent that is
  already available; if none is, fall back to the RDLC choice and say so. The layout file is a
  deliverable in `src/` and is tracked.
- **RDLC layout:** a minimal 2016-schema RDLC with one `DataSet` named `DataSet_Result`, one
  `Tablix` with a header row of the column captions and a detail row of the columns. The
  compiler validates the file; a schema error is fixed before the compile is called clean.
- **No generated layout** (*I'll design the layout in BC*): drop `DefaultRenderingLayout` together with the
  `rendering` block — a `DefaultRenderingLayout` naming a layout that does not exist is a compile error.
- **Processing only:** `ProcessingOnly = true;`, no `rendering` and no `DefaultRenderingLayout`, the work in the dataitem's
  `OnAfterGetRecord` or, better, a codeunit called once from `OnPreReport`.
- Two dataitems: the child nested in the parent with `DataItemLink = "Document No." =
  field("No.")`, `DataItemLinkReference = <parent>`.
- Captions as labels, `IncludeCaption = true` on columns so the layout can use the field
  captions, no hard-coded text in the layout.

## Pre-flight

Every table and field exists in the symbols; column names are valid identifiers (no `.`, no
space — `No_`); `RequestFilterFields` name real fields; the layout file exists at the path
named; the file is `<Name>.Report.al`.

## Offer at close

*A page action that runs this report from the <list page>* (a page extension or an action on the
project's own list) / *Done*.
